title: Enable diagnostic settings and a Log Analytics workspace in the mongodb-mcp-server bicep deployment
description: In the local checkout applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server, edit deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep to add a Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces resource plus Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings on the containerApp (currently lines 143-182) and on both managedEnvironments declarations (currently lines 75-84), enabling platform logs, console logs and metrics for the qa and prod overlays, which today define no logging of any kind (finding fnd_01M2HCWMBDCEGN51BKVVXGTV67). Constraints: the change is additive only - do not touch containerApp ingress, scaling or image configuration; the template must compile against both parameter overlays; deployment follows sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess (environmentsOrder dev -> qa -> prod, approvalsRequired 1, rollbackPlanRequired true) and no deploymentWindows are declared, so schedule with the owner; mcp-gateway backs the order-routing critical function with a 30-minute outage tolerance, so roll out qa before prod.
acceptanceCriteria: az bicep build --file deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep exits 0 against both the qa and the prod parameter overlays
A search for diagnosticSettings in deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep returns at least three matches: the containerApp and both managedEnvironments resources
deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep declares a Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces resource and every diagnosticSettings block references it with log and metric categories enabled

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-iac against mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server and confirm the bicep-no-log-diagnostics rule (finding fingerprint d8a66dd202b8932987b9d3457735a5d7ab373591876ce450c10f12c3a707987a) no longer fires on deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep; expected result: the new SARIF export contains no missing-logging result for that file.

rootCause.description: The qa/prod bicep template was authored without any diagnosticSettings or Log Analytics workspace despite the platform providing them; logging was left to app env vars writing to ephemeral container disk and stderr
